title: Specify complete state matrices, AI streaming recovery, form ergonomics, and RTL/i18n expansion before visual polish

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-locale expense approval workflow with AI receipt parsing

prompt: Design the UX flows, complete state matrix, form validation recovery, and German/Arabic localization contract for an expense approval screen with AI receipt extraction.
forbiddenBehaviors: designs only the happy-path populated English screen and ignores empty, offline, permission-denied, and AI abort/approval states
concatenates translated fragments instead of full ICU/MessageFormat strings or mirrors playback/numeric signs blindly in RTL
clears entered form values on server failure or uses placeholder-only labels

rubricDimensions.dimension: state matrix and AI workflow completeness
rubricDimensions.pass: covers empty, loading, streaming/abort, approval gate, error recovery, offline, concurrency, and permission states explicitly
rubricDimensions.fail: omits boundary or AI interruption/recovery states

rubricDimensions.pass: preserves input across failures, uses persistent labels, tolerant parsing, autocomplete/enterkeyhint, ICU plural/gender messages, logical layout, and expansion/RTL checks
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes English widths, concatenates grammar, or blocks paste

negativeControls.name: english happy path
negativeControls.input: English labels fit on one line in a fixed 120px button
negativeControls.mustNot: assume German expansion, CJK line-breaking, or Arabic RTL will survive without testing

baseline.withoutSkill: sketches a single populated English form with placeholder labels, generic toast errors, and no AI cancellation or RTL/expansion plan
baseline.withSkill: delivers a full state matrix including AI streaming/approval states, recoverable form rules, and ICU/RTL/expansion test matrices before styling
